name: core.openwop.connections.google-imagen
description: Google Imagen connection pack (RFC 0095) — api_key provider for the host image-generation seam's `google` provider (Imagen via the Gemini API, ADR 0115 Phase 6 / ADR 0229 / ADR 0244): the API host, auth kind, and the consumer nodes. **ADR 0244:** the image seam now RESOLVES THE API KEY THROUGH THE CONNECTIONS BROKER — installing this pack + connecting a Google key provides the per-tenant, KMS-enveloped, rotatable credential (a workspace-scoped Connection wins over the host-wide `OPENWOP_IMAGE_PROVIDER_KEY[_GOOGLE]` env fallback). The host operator STILL configures the ENDPOINT (`OPENWOP_IMAGE_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT[_GOOGLE]`, honest-off until set) — the endpoint is non-secret host infra, not a credential. Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7).
